description: This file declares functions and classes related to capturing and processing stack traces, including retrieving stack frames, handling context from signal handlers, and setting custom unwinding functions. It is part of the Abseil debugging library.

methods.name: GetStackFrames
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, and stores their addresses and sizes in provided buffers.

methods.name: GetStackFramesWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, with options to skip frames and note dropped frames.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, returning only addresses.

methods.name: GetStackTraceWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, similar to GetStackTrace but with context support.

methods.name: SetStackUnwinder
methods.description: Sets a custom function for unwinding stack frames, replacing the default unwinder.

methods.name: DefaultStackUnwinder
methods.description: Default implementation for unwinding stack frames, used if no custom unwinder is set.
